contract.description: Read the persona document the human curates for their agents: identity, tone, preferences, rules. The persona is per-tome - each tome carries its own. Call it at session start before writing in the human's voice or making style calls, and whenever a standing instruction might exist - check, don't guess. Empty sections were never filled by the human: do not invent content for them, and do not write persona facts through memory_remember; the human edits persona in the Grimoire UI or CLI. upstream_unavailable means the store is unreachable; the call is read-only and writes nothing.
contract.name: memory_persona_get
contract.title: Get the persona
